result.topic_en: High-precision numerical computation of the fourth powers and squares of the lemniscatic sines of 0.4 and 0.8 (fractions of the period), using closed forms in √5 and square-root extraction.

methods.what: Closed form for the sum of the fourth powers of the lemniscatic sines at 0.4 and 0.8 (fractions of the period), expressed in √5
Closed form for the square of half the difference of these fourth powers
Numerical extraction of a square root to about 30 decimal places, to obtain the half-difference
Recovering the individual values from the half-sum and the half-difference (half-sum minus half-difference gives the smaller value)
Larger fourth power, obtained as half-sum plus half-difference
Square-root extraction giving the square of the lemniscatic sine of 0.4
Square-root extraction giving the square of the lemniscatic sine of 0.8
